lines.text: A hardening in part has come to Israel until the full number of the Gentiles comes in, and so all Israel will be saved.
The Deliverer will come from Sinai and remove godlessness from Jacob, and this is God's covenant with them when He takes away their sins.
Regarding election, Israel is loved on account of the prophets, for God's gifts and His call are irrevocable.
The Gentiles received mercy through Israel's disobedience, and God has consigned everyone to disobedience so that He may have mercy on everyone.
Paul praises the depth of God's wisdom and knowledge, and says from Him and through Him and to Him are all things.
